trigger_explanation: The agent adopted an unverified assumption that a regex-based approach could both preserve exact HTML formatting and provide adequate XSS coverage. Even in step 1, the agent considered html.parser/BeautifulSoup but dismissed it with 'using parser may reformat' without verifying this, and without verifying that regex could avoid reformatting.
